name: Link
description: Adds a dedicated /link page to your Jellyfin server. Visitors sign in once with their server account, then enter the code shown on a TV, phone, or other device to link it instantly, no digging through settings menus required. Built on top of Jellyfin's existing Quick Connect feature.
overview: A plex.tv/link-style device linking page for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Fixes "Sign in failed" on servers with legacy authorization disabled (the default since Jellyfin 12) by authenticating with the standard Authorization: MediaBrowser header. Stamps a real assembly version so the dashboard's enable/disable and uninstall buttons work (the plugin previously reported 0.0.0.0). Honors a configured server base URL.
Initial release: standalone /link page, Quick Connect authorization, and an admin config page for branding.
